ResearchProjectDef.label: M8 prototype serie
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research how to build M8 an advanced battle surrogate series with a limited Sky Cloud core module .

ResearchProjectDef.label: SM7 battle surrogate series
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research how to build SM7 battle surrogate series.

ResearchProjectDef.label: I100 series servers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research how to build I100 security and hacking series servers, cheap but noisy, big and not very efficient.

ResearchProjectDef.label: I300 series servers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research how to build I300 security and hacking series servers, noisy but intermediate in term of efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: I500 series servers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research how to build I500 security and hacking series servers, expensives but very efficient

ResearchProjectDef.label: SkyCloud Core
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research how to build SkyCloud Core servers, which are a powerfull supercomputer which can host several digitized consciousness and allow them to interact with the real world throught every devices connected to the SkyMind network.

ResearchProjectDef.label: VX3 Neural Chip
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research how to build the VX3 chip, a Neural chip allowing his host to control remotely multiple SX androids series and permute/duplicate his consciousness throught a SkyMind network

ResearchProjectDef.label: VX2 Neural Chip
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research how to build the VX2 chip, a Neural chip allowing his host to control remotely SX androids series and permute/duplicate his consciousness throught a SkyMind network

ResearchProjectDef.label: VX1 Neural Chip
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research how to build the VX1 chip, a Neural chip allowing his host to control remotely SX androids series throught a SkyMind network.

ResearchProjectDef.label: VX0 Neural Chip
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research how to build the VX0 chip, a Neural chip which will transform the host into a biological surrogate.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Battery overload
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research how to transform androids into walking bombs, by making their internal battery to explode.

ResearchProjectDef.label: SkyMind Antenna V2
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research how to build SkyMind V2 antenna, which serves as a basis for the transfer of consciousness from one colonist to another and allow to have until 15 colonists simultaneously connected by V2 antenna.

ResearchProjectDef.label: SX androids series
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research how to build surrogate androids series, which is similar to the TX series but with their artificial brains replaced by an advanced remote control system.

ResearchProjectDef.label: SkyMind Antenna V1
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research how to build SkyMind V1 antenna, which serves as a basis for the transfer of consciousness from one colonist to another and allow to have until 3 colonists simultaneously connected by antenna.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Charging station
ResearchProjectDef.description: Allows you to charge up to 8 androids simultaneously directly into internal battery instead through their biomass generator.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Basic NanoKit
ResearchProjectDef.description: Allow you to craft basic nanokit which is required to repair your injured androids

ResearchProjectDef.label: Intermediate NanoKit
ResearchProjectDef.description: Allow you to craft intermediate nanokit which is required to repair your injured androids

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced NanoKit
ResearchProjectDef.description: Allow you to craft intermediate nanokit which is required to repair your injured androids

ResearchProjectDef.label: Cure old age malfunction
ResearchProjectDef.description: Allows you to craft mechanites to cure old age android malfunctions

ResearchProjectDef.label: Basic robotics
ResearchProjectDef.description: As simple as advanced robotics can get, research into the anatomy of the body and how to mimic it into mechanical form.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Basic Artificial creatures
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research into the development of simple recreations of biological animals. Allowing the development of M.U.F.F Units; strong caravaning creatures that can carry lots of weight on their back.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced Artificial creatures
ResearchProjectDef.description: Developing further on the previous research, this project will look into utility based creatures. Imiations of common farmland animals from Earth, such as the Phytomining Unit.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Experimental Artificial creatures
ResearchProjectDef.description: Extremely complex robotic creatures that have never been more than a concept for most planets. These include Swarm Mortar shells, small capsules filled with hunter-seeker drones and the K-9 Cybernetic unit, a strong and quick creature once designed for extreme crowd control.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Basic enhancements
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research into basic consumable enhancements that aid mechanical pawns for a short amount of time.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced enhancements
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research into highly advanced consumable enhancements that give the pawn an immense level of ability for a short amount of time.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Android upgrade station
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct android upgrade stations and upgrade cabinets which improve android operation outcomes.

ResearchProjectDef.label: T1 androids
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research into how to produce machines that are capable of being sapient, albeit at a very basic level compared to the abilities of actual humans.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Basic replacement parts
ResearchProjectDef.description: find ways to develop basic replacement parts that are interchangable between all models of android, allowing for longer lasting lifespans.

ResearchProjectDef.label: T2 androids
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop more onto the design of the T1 Android and find more efficient ways of locomotion and how to capacitate for a larger mental span.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced programming
ResearchProjectDef.description: Researching this tech will allow you to reprogram androids in a magnitude of ways from: converting prisoners to randomizing android personality.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Basic android plating
ResearchProjectDef.description: develop ways to attach plates of armour to androids without hindering motor capacities.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Composite android plating
ResearchProjectDef.description: develop ways to produce composite plating that can be fitted to androids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced replacement limbs
ResearchProjectDef.description: enchancing the previous models of replacement limbs to allow for more efficient movements for tier 3/4 androids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced replacement internals
ResearchProjectDef.description: enchancing the previous models of replacement parts to allow for more efficient internals for tier 3/4 androids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Android mind implants
ResearchProjectDef.description: Implants that give a variety of bonuses ranging from mining upgrades to combat upgrades.

ResearchProjectDef.label: T3 androids
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research into machine bodies that can perfectly mimic human movement and personality, to the point where their appearance may be the only distinguishable trait.

ResearchProjectDef.label: T4 androids
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research how to develop cutting edge robotics that includes: pseudo muscle fibers that operate much like a human counterpart but at much higher efficiencies, positronic brainmaps, and intricate modular frameworks. Allowing the construction of the T4 Android.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Archotech upgrades
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research into archotech level upgrades, this level of technology is incomprehensable by most life, requiring a T5 Android to develop; as only they possess enough mental complexity to understand it.\n\n [ ONLY A T5 ANDROID CAN RESEARCH THIS TECH. ]
